units.source_text: 午休之后，名人刚落座，就下了白70。

en.t: After the lunch break, as soon as the Master had taken his seat, he played White 70.

units.source_text: 午休是吃饭时间，也就是说不计算在规定的时限之内。

en.t: The lunch break was mealtime; in other words, it did not count against the allotted time limit.

units.source_text: 大家都明白，名人在这段时间里仍在继续思考。

en.t: Everyone understood that the Master was still continuing to think during that time.

units.source_text: 为了不让别人觉察，下午开始的一手，本应佯装略作思考的样子，可是名人没有这种本事。

en.t: To keep others from noticing, he should have pretended to think a little before making the first move of the afternoon session, but the Master did not have that knack.

units.source_text: 相反，吃午饭的时间，他也凝视着虚空。

en.t: On the contrary, even during lunch, he stared into empty space.
